description: What the MacBook Air M4 actually costs in the United States right now: live prices from Apple, Amazon, Best Buy and B&H, with advice on 13 vs 15-inch, 16 GB RAM, AppleCare, and when leftover M4 stock still beats a new M5.

heroBody: In the United States the MacBook Air M4 is no longer the newest Air — M5 13-inch and 15-inch configs now sit next to it at Apple, Amazon and Best Buy — but M4 13-inch 16 GB machines still show up as leftover and refurbished stock, often at a meaningful gap below current M5 list. These are US-dollar prices sold into the United States. This page pulls live listings from BuyWhere's catalog so you can see the current floor, whether a listing is AppleCare, a dock, or an actual Air, and whether the cheaper unit is M4 or already an M5.

highlightSectionTitle: What US M4 Air shoppers get wrong

highlights.title: The catalog now mixes M4 leftover with M5 current
highlights.body: A search for MacBook Air M4 in the US often returns 13-inch M5 machines and AppleCare SKUs. That is expected after the M5 launch. Use the live cards and the spec line: if it says M5, you are not looking at the leftover M4 discount you came for — you may still want it.

highlights.title: 256 GB SSD is the regret spec, not the chip
highlights.body: On leftover M4 Airs the painful config is still 256 GB. macOS plus Photos plus a modest Xcode install fills it. Prefer 512 GB even if that means a current M5 13-inch instead of a cheap M4 256.

highlights.title: 16 GB RAM is the real M4 story
highlights.body: Apple's later M4 Airs in the US standardised on 16 GB. Avoid any remaining 8 GB rumour-stock or mislabelled older Airs. If a listing is far below the floor, it is often an M2/M3 or a dock.

highlights.title: Education and warehouse beat list more than coupon sites
highlights.body: US education pricing, Amazon Warehouse, and Best Buy open-box 'excellent' are the honest discount paths. Random coupon blogs listing 'M4 Air' often resolve to hubs or other-country stores that will not honour US AppleCare.

adviceSectionTitle: How to pay less for a US MacBook Air without getting a dock
advicePoints: Confirm the chip in the title and the spec table. M4 leftover is the hunt; M5 current is often the better four-year buy.
Ignore AppleCare+, USB-C hubs, and Thunderbolt docks in the price table — they are not the laptop.
Buy from Apple, Amazon sold-by-Amazon, Best Buy, or B&H. Third-party 'import' Airs may be other-region keyboards.
If 256 GB is the only M4 left, spend the difference on a 512 GB M5 instead of living on an external SSD.
Compare /best-macbooks-us if you might want a 14-inch Pro instead — Pro thermals matter if you compile all day.
faqSectionTitle: MacBook Air M4 price in the US — questions shoppers actually ask

faqs.question: Is the MacBook Air M4 still sold in the US in 2026?
faqs.answer: As leftover, warehouse and open-box more than as Apple's current Air. Current list is M5. The live cards show whatever the catalog still prices.

faqs.question: Should I buy leftover M4 or a new M5 Air in the United States?
faqs.answer: Buy leftover M4 if the gap is large and you only browse, write and video-call. Buy M5 if you want the longer software window and a 512 GB config.

faqs.question: Does AppleCare+ transfer on open-box US Airs?
faqs.answer: AppleCare+ is tied to the serial. Open-box from Best Buy is often still eligible if unused days remain; Amazon Warehouse varies. Check the serial on checkcoverage.apple.com before you add a plan.

faqs.question: Why do some 'M4 Air' listings cost under a few hundred dollars?
faqs.answer: They are almost always docks, cases or AppleCare — not the computer. This page's floor price is meant to hide those.

categoryIntro.heading: Why US MacBook Air M4 search mixed chips this year
categoryIntro.body: Apple moved the US Air line to M5 while Amazon and Best Buy still hold M4 serials and a pile of Thunderbolt accessories branded for M4 Air. A static price article goes stale the week a warehouse dump lands. This page is a live catalog pull so the floor is honest.
